set.body: Package the flagship inherited-query demonstration from one fitted relation and one spatial frame. Produce the signed retained-first-moment effect, coherent crossvalidated energy, configuration crossvalidated energy, total energy, squared-distance RDM, and fixed linear RSA coefficient. Acceptance: public-data or planted-effect workflow, one declared plan lineage, total = coherent + configuration at a declared numerical tolerance at every location, independent oracle, negative crossvalidated estimates preserved, and interpretation anchored to univariate/multivariate, mean-pattern, PCM, and second-moment literature. The claim is exact additive non-destructive accounting inherited by every fixed linear query.
set.title: Gate 2: one plan yields the coherent, configuration, geometry, and RSA family
